environment.description: ARM Cortex-A53 gateway running Yocto Linux 3.1 (dunfell), kernel 5.4.72 with default configuration. Binary compiled with GCC 9.3 using -O2 (no stack protector, no PIE, no ASLR - standard for this BSP). MQTT broker accepts connections from any device on the local LoRaWAN segment. PostgreSQL 12 on db.internal with device_writer_* roles having INSERT privilege on device_telemetry table. No network segmentation between MQTT handler and database.
